title: Retry Commons Lang UTF-16 search on the original native claims
description: Retry the five frozen tasks on the original StringBuilder adapter, upstream classes, UTF-16 input encoding and native strict policy. The checker now builds surrogate pairs and handles the Unicode block compiled by the upstream class initializer. The public route independently checks adapter correspondence on every one of 160 inputs per revision and replays each reported counterexample.
expected: The parent misses a supplementary last match and the repair is established. Both absent-character properties and the single-code-unit comparison are established. Each retry keeps the original byte binding.

resources.notes: A strict fixed-revision last-match probe completed in under one second. Preparation is shared by the batch.
